name: Only-Fan-Controller
description: Quiet, threshold-based fan control for Dell PowerEdge (iDRAC) servers, with optional NVIDIA GPU monitoring and Home Assistant integration.

variables.name: iDRAC Host
variables.description: iDRAC IP address (IPMI over LAN must be enabled)

variables.name: API Token
variables.description: Optional bearer token to change fans/hints via the HTTP API from other LAN hosts. Blank = local host only (does not affect Home Assistant/MQTT control).

variables.name: Enable MQTT (Home Assistant)
variables.description: Enable the Home Assistant MQTT bridge (self-registers via MQTT Discovery)

variables.name: MQTT Broker
variables.description: MQTT broker. Just the IP works (e.g. 192.168.1.10); host:port or tcp://host:port also fine. Defaults to port 1883 (Mosquitto). This is the MQTT broker, NOT Home Assistant's web UI on 8123.

variables.name: Enable GPU Monitoring
variables.description: Monitor NVIDIA GPU temps. If you enable this, also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (requires the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin). Leave off on CPU-only systems.

variables.name: Idle Fan Speed %
variables.description: Base fan speed when temps are below thresholds

variables.name: CPU Threshold C
variables.description: Bump fans above this CPU temp. Keep below the 85C critical limit.

variables.name: GPU Threshold C
variables.description: Bump fans above this GPU temp. Keep below the 90C critical limit.

variables.name: Cooldown Delay s
variables.description: Seconds below threshold before ramping fans down
